name: api-fuzzing
description: Fuzz-test APIs (RESTler/schemathesis) against the schema: malformed inputs, edge cases, security. Use to find robustness/security bugs in APIs.

name: flaky-test-management
description: Detect, quarantine and fix flaky tests: retries vs root cause, isolation, determinism, tracking. Use when tests fail intermittently.

name: test-data-management
description: Manage test data: fixtures, factories, seeding, isolation, cleanup, no real PII. Use for reliable, repeatable tests.

name: synthetic-monitoring
description: Monitor production with synthetic checks: uptime, critical journeys, API probes, alerting. Use to catch outages before users do.
pitfalls: Probes that don't reflect real journeys

name: accessibility-testing
description: Test accessibility automatically and manually (axe, screen readers, keyboard): WCAG conformance, real assistive-tech checks. Use to verify a11y.
pitfalls: Testing after ship instead of in CI

name: performance-testing
description: Test performance under load and regression: thresholds, percentiles, CI gates, profiling. Use to prevent perf regressions.

name: coverage-gap-analysis
description: Find meaningful coverage gaps in changed/critical code: branch/path coverage, risk-based prioritization. Use to target testing effort.
pitfalls: Chasing a global % over critical paths

name: test-parallelization
description: Speed up test suites: sharding, parallelism, isolation, caching, selective testing. Use when tests are slow.

name: saga-orchestration
description: Coordinate distributed transactions with sagas: orchestration vs choreography, compensations, idempotency. Use for cross-service consistency.

name: transactional-outbox
description: Reliably publish events with the outbox pattern: atomic DB write + event, relay, dedup. Use to avoid dual-write inconsistency.

name: idempotent-consumers
description: Build consumers that safely process at-least-once delivery: dedup keys, idempotent writes, ordering. Use for reliable event processing.

name: bff-pattern
description: Build Backends-for-Frontends: per-client aggregation, tailored APIs, auth, avoiding a shared god-gateway. Use for multi-client apps.
pitfalls: BFF becoming a fat shared layer

name: graphql-federation
description: Compose a federated GraphQL supergraph: subgraphs, entities, gateway, schema ownership. Use for GraphQL at org scale.

name: api-versioning
description: Version APIs without breaking clients: URI/header/media-type versioning, deprecation, sunset, evolution. Use when changing public APIs.
pitfalls: Breaking changes without a new version

name: multi-tenancy
description: Design multi-tenant systems: isolation (row/schema/db), tenant routing, noisy-neighbor, per-tenant limits. Use for SaaS platforms.

name: service-discovery
description: Discover and route to services: registries (Consul/etcd), DNS, health, client vs server-side LB. Use for dynamic service topology.
pitfalls: Stale registry entries routing to dead nodes

name: backpressure-flow-control
description: Apply backpressure and flow control: bounded queues, credit-based flow, load shedding, timeouts. Use to prevent overload cascades.

name: resilience-patterns
description: Build resilient services: circuit breaker, bulkhead, retry-with-backoff, timeout, fallback. Use for fault-tolerant integrations.

name: micro-frontends
description: Build micro-frontends: module federation, composition, shared deps, isolation, routing. Use to split a large frontend across teams.

name: web-components
description: Build framework-agnostic Web Components (custom elements, shadow DOM, slots, Lit). Use for reusable, portable UI widgets.

name: state-machines
description: Model UI/logic with state machines/statecharts (XState): explicit states, transitions, guards, side effects. Use for complex stateful flows.

name: offline-first
description: Build offline-first apps: local-first data, sync/conflict resolution (CRDTs), queueing, caching. Use for resilient/offline UX.

name: web-workers
description: Offload work to Web/Service Workers: threading, message passing, transferables, WASM. Use to keep the main thread responsive.

name: css-architecture
description: Architect scalable CSS: methodology (BEM/utility/CSS-in-JS), cascade layers, tokens, no specificity wars. Use for maintainable styling at scale.

name: web-animations
description: Build performant web animations: transforms/opacity, will-change, FLIP, prefers-reduced-motion, jank avoidance. Use for smooth motion.

name: module-federation
description: Share code at runtime with Module Federation: remotes, shared singletons, versioning, fallback. Use for micro-frontends/plugin UIs.
pitfalls: Remote load failures with no fallback

name: llm-guardrails
description: Add guardrails to LLM outputs: input/output validation, content policy, PII redaction, allow/deny, schema enforcement. Use for safe LLM features.

name: prompt-injection-defense
description: Defend against prompt injection: treat tool/content output as data, isolation, allowlists, no blind tool execution. Use for agentic/RAG systems.

name: rag-evaluation
description: Evaluate RAG pipelines: retrieval recall/precision, groundedness, faithfulness, answer quality, golden sets. Use to measure RAG quality.
pitfalls: Eval set unrepresentative of real queries

name: model-registry
description: Manage models in a registry (MLflow/W&B): versioning, staging, lineage, approvals, rollback. Use for governed model deployment.

name: llm-observability
description: Observe LLM apps: tracing prompts/responses, token/cost/latency, quality signals, feedback capture. Use to debug and improve LLM features.

name: semantic-caching
description: Cache LLM/embedding results semantically: similarity-based cache, TTL, invalidation, cost savings. Use to cut LLM cost/latency.

name: structured-output
description: Get reliable structured output from LLMs: JSON schema/tool-calling, validation, repair, streaming partials. Use for machine-readable LLM output.
pitfalls: Parsing free text instead of enforcing schema

name: agent-memory
description: Design agent memory: short/long-term, summarization, retrieval, vector stores, forgetting. Use for stateful agents.

name: multimodal-ai
description: Build multimodal AI (vision+text+audio): input handling, grounding, cost, safety, evaluation. Use for image/audio+text features.

name: llm-routing
description: Route LLM requests across models by cost/quality/latency: cascades, fallbacks, small-then-large, budgets. Use to optimize LLM cost/quality.

name: pony
description: Write Pony: actor-model, capabilities-secure, data-race-free systems language. Use for .pony files. Detect ponyc first.

name: chapel
description: Write Chapel: parallel/HPC language with data and task parallelism. Use for .chpl files. Detect chpl first.

name: hare
description: Write Hare: simple, stable systems language. Use for .ha files. Detect the hare binary first.

name: unison
description: Write Unison: content-addressed functional language with built-in distribution. Use for Unison code. Detect ucm first.
pitfalls: Thinking in files vs the codebase manager

name: koka
description: Write Koka: functional language with algebraic effect handlers. Use for .kk files. Detect koka first.

name: grain
description: Write Grain: a functional language compiling to WebAssembly. Use for .gr files. Detect grain first.

name: wren
description: Write Wren: small, fast, class-based scripting language for embedding. Use for .wren files. Detect the wren binary first.

name: janet
description: Write Janet: a Lisp-like functional/imperative language for scripting and embedding. Use for .janet files. Detect janet first.

name: devcontainers
description: Define reproducible dev environments with devcontainers: devcontainer.json, features, Codespaces, prebuilds. Use for consistent onboarding.

name: conventional-commits
description: Adopt Conventional Commits: types/scopes, commitlint, automated changelog/versioning. Use to standardize commit history.

name: code-owners
description: Use CODEOWNERS for review routing and ownership: patterns, required reviewers, team mapping. Use to enforce review ownership.

name: pr-automation
description: Automate pull requests: templates, auto-labeling, size checks, required checks, merge queues, bots. Use to streamline PR flow.
pitfalls: Giant PRs with no size gate

name: renovate-dependencies
description: Automate dependency updates (Renovate/Dependabot): grouping, schedules, automerge policy, security-only. Use to keep deps current safely.

name: durable-execution
description: Build durable, long-running workflows (Temporal/Restate): deterministic workflows, activities, retries, timers, state. Use for reliable orchestration.

name: workflow-engines
description: Model business workflows (BPMN/Camunda/Airflow/Argo): tasks, gateways, human tasks, compensation. Use for orchestrated processes.

name: event-mesh
description: Design an event mesh/EDA backbone: schemas, topics, routing, discovery, governance across services. Use for large event-driven systems.

name: semantic-layer
description: Build a semantic/metrics layer (dbt Metrics/Cube/LookML): consistent definitions, governance, self-serve BI. Use to standardize metrics.

name: headless-commerce
description: Build headless/composable commerce: API-first storefront, cart/checkout services, CMS, payments. Use for flexible commerce architectures.
